programme.desc: Nina é uma ratinha aventureira que sonha em se tornar uma grande heroína. Na companhia de seu fiel escudeiro, o gato Sam, ela decide ajudar o velho herói Jasão e seus Argonautas a salvar a cidade de Iolcos, na Grécia, da fúria de Poseidon.
programme.title: Nina - A Heroína dos Sete Mares

programme.desc: Martina é uma viúva argentina que procura há mais de 30 anos pelo neto, nascido em cativeiro durante a ditadura militar. A necessidade de encontrá-lo se torna ainda mais urgente ao receber o diagnóstico de Alzheimer. Quando Martina descobre que o neto pode estar no Brasil, ela embarca em uma jornada em que passado e presente se misturam, transformando essa busca em uma luta contra o esquecimento.
programme.title: A Procura de Martina

programme.desc: Leonardo chega aos 50 anos frustrado com a carreira na publicidade, a vida amorosa e sua relação conturbada com o pai, Álvaro. A convivência entre os dois se intensifica quando Álvaro, já aposentado, passa a morar com o filho, trazendo à tona conflitos antigos e traumas de infância. Após uma discussão intensa, Leonardo encontra uma antiga caixa de memórias e, ao olhar uma foto de quando era criança, é transportado para 1986.
programme.title: Voltei na Foto

programme.desc: Mãe e filha sobrevivem em um mundo sem oxigênio e precisam cuidar uma da outra.
programme.title: Respire

programme.desc: Um homem permite que sua esposa tenha relações com outras pessoas para tentar salvar seu casamento. Porém, quando os amantes dela começam a desaparecer, o marido se torna o principal suspeito.
programme.title: Águas Profundas

programme.desc: Tom Carter é um lendário ladrão de bancos. Mas sua vida muda quando ele se apaixona por Annie e decide deixar o crime para trás. Ele aceita se entregar para a justiça, mas não imaginava que seria enganado por policiais corruptos.
programme.title: Legado Explosivo

programme.desc: Os discípulos de Jesus se unem pela última vez antes da traição iminente. Cristo se prepara para oferecer o sacrifício final enquanto seus seguidores se veem perdidos sem o Mestre.
programme.title: A Última Ceia

programme.desc: Após uma pandemia que transformou pessoas em lobisomens durante a superlua, dois cientistas tentam impedir uma nova mutação. Mas o experimento sai do controle e a ameaça retorna com força total.
programme.title: A Noite dos Lobisomens

programme.desc: Uma antiga feiticeira volta à vida decidida a vingar-se de uma traição do passado. Dividido entre o mundo sobrenatural e humano, o lendário meio-demônio Hellboy recebe a missão de conter essa ameaça e salvar o mundo.
programme.title: Hellboy

programme.desc: Em meio ao luto, o músico Murilo encontra Marlene, enfermeira que vive um relacionamento tóxico. O destino os conecta a uma policial sedenta por vingança e um advogado misterioso, levando todos a uma jornada sem volta.
programme.title: Cinco Tipos de Medo

programme.desc: Uma ex-agente da KGB que virou chef usa suas habilidades letais para salvar seu restaurante de um sindicato do crime que quer cobrar uma dívida de seu marido.
programme.title: Calor Mortal

programme.desc: Pinóquio quer conhecer o mundo e, por isso, entra para um circo. Lá, ele encontra o amor, ao se apaixonar pela adorável Bela, e o mal, quando descobre que o diretor do circo é, na verdade, um ladrão.
programme.title: Pinocchio - O Menino de Madeira

programme.desc: Jefinho sonha em se tornar um cantor de pagode famoso e, para tanto, se dispõe a tudo, até mesmo limpar a piscina do dono da gravadora, de olho em uma possível oportunidade.
programme.title: Os Suburbanos - O Filme

programme.desc: Mãe percebe que o filho está se comportando de maneira diferente e vai até a escola atrás de respostas. Três pontos de vista diferentes revelam a verdade sobre o menino.
programme.title: Monstro

programme.desc: Dona Hermínia precisa se reinventar porque seus filhos estão formando novas famílias. Marcelina está grávida e Juliano vai casar. Dona Hermínia está mais ansiosa do que nunca. Para completar as confusões, Carlos Alberto, seu ex-marido, que esteve sempre por perto, resolve se mudar para o apartamento ao lado.
programme.title: Minha Mãe É uma Peça 3

programme.desc: Agora mãe solteira, Bridget Jones mergulha novamente no mundo dos encontros. Ela se vê dividida entre um homem mais jovem e o professor de ciências de seu filho.
programme.title: Bridget Jones - Louca pelo Garoto

programme.desc: Entertainment Matérias especiais sobre o mundo da sétima arte, o cinema.
programme.title: Preview

programme.desc: Laura precisa lidar com um câncer e um término de namoro. Ela vê seu mundo ficar ainda mais caótico quando encontra um charmoso monstro dentro de seu armário.
programme.title: Minha Fera

programme.desc: Após o desmoronamento de uma mina de diamantes, Mike McCann, um experiente motorista de caminhão, é recrutado por Jim Goldenrod para liderar uma missão de resgate. Ele e sua equipe têm apenas 30 horas para transportar uma enorme carga sobre rios congelados e tentarem salvar a vida dos mineradores soterrados.
programme.title: Missão Resgate

programme.desc: M3GAN é uma maravilha da inteligência artificial, uma boneca realista programada para ser a melhor amiga de uma criança. Uma robótica brilhante dá a sua jovem sobrinha um protótipo M3GAN, mas a máquina logo se torna violenta.
programme.title: M3gan

programme.desc: Max sempre viveu pela velocidade. Em um mundo que a rejeitou, um ex-piloto ousado mantém a fé e persegue um único objetivo: torná-la a mais rápida de todas.
programme.title: Faster - No Limite da Velocidade

programme.desc: Um prisioneiro político chamado Valentín divide a cela com um homem chamado Molina. Eles formam um vínculo improvável enquanto Molina narra a trama de um musical de Hollywood.
programme.title: O Beijo da Mulher Aranha

programme.desc: Comandos das Forças Especiais são sequestrados em plena operação por uma nave espacial misteriosa e, ao despertar, tornam-se vítimas de uma raça alienígena implacável em uma luta pela sobrevivência.
programme.title: Osíris

programme.desc: Martina é uma viúva argentina que procura há mais de 30 anos pelo neto, nascido em cativeiro durante a ditadura militar. A necessidade de encontrá-lo se torna ainda mais urgente ao receber o diagnóstico de Alzheimer. Quando Martina descobre que o neto pode estar no Brasil, ela embarca em uma jornada em que passado e presente se misturam, transformando essa busca em uma luta contra o esquecimento.
programme.title: A Procura de Martina

programme.desc: Alice é uma adolescente trans cheia de carisma que investe seu tempo fazendo vídeos para o YouTube. Um dia, seu pai, Jean, é transferido pela empresa do Recife para Araucárias do Sul, e eles precisam se mudar. Na nova escola, Alice enfrenta preconceitos ao se deparar com uma sociedade mais retrógrada do que estava acostumada. O desejo da menina é dar seu primeiro beijo, mas, antes de tudo, quer o direito de ser quem ela é.
programme.title: Alice Júnior

programme.desc: Uma jornada de resistência e coragem, ambientada na vibrante Salvador de 1835. Durante seu casamento, dois jovens muçulmanos são arrancados de sua terra natal na África e escravizados no Brasil. Separados por destino cruel, ambos lutam para sobreviverem e reencontrarem-se, enquanto se veem envolvidos na maior insurreição de escravizados da história do Brasil: a Revolta dos Malês.
programme.title: Malês

programme.desc: O renomado escritor Charles Dickens compartilha a história de Jesus Cristo com seu filho, Walter. Enquanto seu pai narra o emocionante conto, Walter fica cativado pelos eventos da vida de Jesus.
programme.title: O Rei dos Reis

programme.desc: Bebel é uma jovem cadeirante que mora com a mãe e o avô no interior. Para continuar seus estudos, ela acaba se mudando para a cidade grande, onde novas adversidades passam a fazer parte de sua vida, começando com sua tia Marieta. Na escola, seu engajamento nas questões ambientais faz com que rapidamente ela exerça uma certa liderança. No entanto, um poderoso magnata local não gosta nem um pouco desse ativismo a favor do meio ambiente na sua região.
programme.title: Chama a Bebel

programme.desc: Ao descobrir que o pai já foi espião, Maya se vê no centro de uma conspiração internacional, precisando desvendar segredos antigos para sobreviver.
programme.title: A Herança

programme.desc: As delícias, estranhezas e dificuldades dos relacionamentos amorosos contemporâneos.
programme.title: Todo Mundo Ainda Tem Problemas Sexuais

programme.desc: Um ano após a queda da civilização por uma epidemia viral, ex-agente do FBI precisa proteger uma jovem imune à doença de um perigoso criminoso.
programme.title: O Sobrevivente

programme.desc: Jessica volta para a casa de sua infância e sua enteada mais nova, Alice, encontra um urso de pelúcia chamado Chauncey. O comportamento de Alice se torna cada vez mais preocupante e Jessica percebe que Chauncey é muito mais que um brinquedo.
programme.title: Imaginário - Brinquedo Diabólico

programme.desc: Uma jornalista, após o assassinato do filho, forma uma aliança improvável com a namorada dele para procurar os responsáveis pela sua morte.
programme.title: Por Trás da Verdade

programme.desc: Após 20 anos longe, Odisseu é lançado às margens de Ítaca. O rei descobre que muito mudou desde que partiu para lutar. Não sendo mais o poderoso guerreiro que seu povo lembra, Odisseu deve enfrentar seu passado para salvar sua família.
programme.title: O Retorno

programme.desc: Após uma pandemia que transformou pessoas em lobisomens durante a superlua, dois cientistas tentam impedir uma nova mutação. Mas o experimento sai do controle e a ameaça retorna com força total.
programme.title: A Noite dos Lobisomens

programme.desc: A judoca iraniana Leila e sua treinadora participam do Campeonato Mundial de Judô com o objetivo de conquistar a primeira medalha de ouro para o Irã. Durante o evento, elas enfrentam um ultimato do governo da República Islâmica.
programme.title: Tatame

programme.desc: William Thacker é dono de uma livraria em Londres. A monotonia de sua existência é tumultuada romanticamente quando a famosa atriz estadunidense Anna Scott aparece em sua loja. Um encontro fortuito sobre um suco de laranja derramado leva a um beijo que dá início a um caso de amor. Conforme ele e a glamorosa estrela de cinema se aproximam cada vez mais, eles lutam para conciliar seus estilos de vida radicalmente diferentes em nome do amor.
programme.title: Um Lugar Chamado Notting Hill

programme.desc: Uma editora de livros assume uma livraria em dezembro e, entre conflitos e descobertas, reacende sua criatividade e encontra amor onde menos espera.
programme.title: O Manuscrito do Amor

programme.desc: Alice sofre um colapso nervoso de tanto trabalhar e se interna em um spa para se livrar do estresse. Porém, o momento não poderia ser mais inoportuno, pois a rede de sex shop está para abrir sua primeira loja no exterior e Alice vai tentar de tudo para voltar ao trabalho e salvar seu casamento.
programme.title: De Pernas pro Ar 2

programme.desc: Com a vida desmoronando ao seu redor, Linda tenta lidar com a misteriosa doença de seu filho, seu marido ausente, uma pessoa desaparecida e um relacionamento cada vez mais hostil com seu terapeuta.
programme.title: Se Eu Tivesse Pernas, Eu te Chutaria

programme.desc: Antes de apagar as velas em sua festa de 25 anos, André deseja que o tempo pare de passar. E, para sua surpresa, seu desejo é atendido.
programme.title: Nesta Data Querida

programme.desc: Por conta da carreira política do marido Gero, Lúcia abandona seu sonho de ser bailarina. Porém, um episódio envolvendo um influente senador pode ser a chance de um novo recomeço para Lúcia.
programme.title: Uma Loucura de Mulher

programme.desc: Lina Cruz muda de uma escolar pública para uma escola de ensino médio particular, cheia de adolescentes esnobes, onde ela tem dificuldades de se encaixar. Ela tenta entrar no grupo das animadoras de torcida, mas tem problemas com uma pedante chefe de torcida, que é irmã do rapaz por quem ela está apaixonada.
programme.title: As Apimentadas - Ainda Mais Apimentadas

programme.desc: Os desafios da paternidade iminente viram as vidas de cinco casais de cabeça para baixo. Duas celebridades se desesperam com demandas surpreendentes da gravidez. Hormônios causam estragos em uma autora louca por bebês, enquanto marido tenta não ser superado por seu pai, que espera gêmeos com sua jovem esposa troféu. O marido de uma fotógrafa não tem certeza dos planos de adoção da esposa. Uma conexão única resulta em uma gravidez surpresa para os proprietários rivais de caminhões de alimentos.
programme.title: O que Esperar Quando Você Está Esperando

programme.desc: Nelson é publicitário em São Francisco. Um dia ele conhece Sara, que é muito diferente de todas as outras mulheres em sua vida. Ambos concordam em se relacionar durante um mês, a título de experiência. Aquele novembro mudará suas vidas.
programme.title: Doce Novembro

programme.desc: Paige Morgan é uma boa aluna que se apaixona por Eddie, aluno dinamarquês de intercâmbio. Ela descobre que ele é o herdeiro do trono da Dinamarca e entende que terá que superar alguns obstáculos para ficar com ele.
programme.title: Um Príncipe em Minha Vida

programme.desc: Entertainment Acompanhe matérias especiais sobre o mundo da sétima arte, o cinema.
programme.title: Preview

programme.desc: Seth é um anjo encarregado de tomar conta de Los Angeles, que se apaixona pela mortal Maggie, uma cirurgiã. Ela fica transtornada ao perder um paciente na mesa de cirurgia e Seth acompanha seu sofrimento e desenvolve por ela sentimentos que ameaçam sua condição imortal. Para viver esse amor intensamente, Seth considera desistir da eternidade.
programme.title: Cidade dos Anjos

programme.desc: Em uma iniciativa de reparação pelo passado escravocrata, o governo brasileiro decreta uma medida provisória e provoca uma reação imediata no Congresso Nacional. Os parlamentares aprovam uma medida que obriga os cidadãos negros a se mudar para a África na intenção de retomar as suas origens. A aprovação afeta diretamente a vida do casal formado pela médica Capitu e pelo advogado Antonio, além de seu primo, o jornalista André, que mora com eles no mesmo apartamento.
programme.title: Medida Provisória

programme.desc: Memo, um pastor de ovelhas com deficiência mental, vive com sua filha e avó em uma vila na costa turca do mar Egeu. Um dia, sua vida é virada de cabeça para baixo quando a filha do comandante morre e Memo é acusado do assassinato e condenado à morte.
programme.title: Milagre na Cela 7

programme.desc: Joel se surpreende ao saber que seu amor verdadeiro, Clementine, o apagou completamente de sua memória. Ele decide fazer o mesmo, mas muda de ideia. Preso dentro da própria mente enquanto os especialistas se mantêm ocupados em seu apartamento, Joel precisa avisá-los para parar.
programme.title: Brilho Eterno de uma Mente sem Lembranças

programme.desc: Elizabeth Tudor torna-se a rainha de uma dividida e perigosa Inglaterra em 1558. Ela é vista como fraca por ameaças de todo lugar e é altamente aconselhada a se casar por um advogado William Cecil, mas ela só vai se casar com seu país. Inteligente e cautelosa, ela deve escolher onde colocar a sua confiança: com seu astuto secretário Walsingham, um mestre da espionagem, ou seu amante secreto, Sir Robert Dudley.
programme.title: Elizabeth

programme.desc: As estudantes Whittier e Monica entram para o time de animadoras de torcida da universidade, mas não suportam sua esnobe líder, Tina. As duas decidem montar a sua própria equipe, selecionando um grupo de estudantes de arte que tiveram seus cursos extracurriculares cortados devido à redução do orçamento da escola. Com muito trabalho em equipe, elas desafiam o direito do esquadrão oficial de representar a escola no próximo campeonato de animadoras de torcida.
programme.title: As Apimentadas - Mandando Ver

programme.desc: Silvia é uma cineasta de meia-idade em crise com sua vida. Na mesma noite em que é surpreendida pela visita da ex-esposa, que a largou há alguns anos, conhece outra mulher que a fascina.
programme.title: Tea for Two

programme.desc: Fernanda está casada com Tom, com quem tem uma filha de cinco anos, Joana. O casal está em meio ao desgaste causado pelo convívio de muitos anos, o que gera atritos constantes. Quem ajuda Fernanda a superar a crise é seu sócio Aníbal, parceiro inseparável durante a árdua jornada entre salvar o casamento ou colocar um fim nele.
programme.title: Minha Vida em Marte

programme.desc: Em 1841, Solomon Northup, negro livre com família, é sequestrado após aceitar um trabalho e vendido como escravo. Por 12 anos enfrenta humilhações físicas e emocionais sob dois senhores, Ford e Epps, lutando para sobreviver à exploração.
programme.title: 12 Anos de Escravidão

programme.desc: Depois da partida de Edward, Jacob se transforma no melhor amigo de Bella. Mas o que ela não imagina é que Jacob também tem um segredo que mudará suas vidas repentinamente.
programme.title: A Saga Crepúsculo - Lua Nova

programme.desc: A judoca iraniana Leila e sua treinadora participam do Campeonato Mundial de Judô com o objetivo de conquistar a primeira medalha de ouro para o Irã. Durante o evento, elas enfrentam um ultimato do governo da República Islâmica.
programme.title: Tatame

programme.desc: Grace e Emma pedem demissão para conhecer Paris. A viagem é um verdadeiro fiasco até que Grace é confundida com uma socialite bem-sucedida e as garotas passam a usufruir de todas as regalias da alta sociedade.
programme.title: Monte Carlo

programme.desc: Das raízes em Trenchtown até a fama mundial, o filme delineia a revolução musical de Bob Marley e sua importância como ativista político. A trama se desenvolve através dos altos e baixos de sua carreira.
programme.title: Bob Marley: One Love

programme.desc: Nando trabalha como entregador em uma lanchonete de Copacabana e sonha em ser uma estrela do trap, mas não tem muitas oportunidades. Até que ele conhece Jaque, uma moça acostumada desde cedo a se virar para sobreviver - nem sempre da forma mais convencional. Jaque acredita no potencial de Nando e decide, à sua maneira, lançá-lo como artista.
programme.title: Confia - Sonho de Cria

programme.desc: Após ser dispensada por seu noivo, Joy McNally decide chorar as mágoas em Las Vegas. Lá, ela conhece Jack Fuller, que foi demitido por seu próprio pai. Depois de uma noite de diversão e bebedeira, os dois acordam e descobrem que se casaram. Antes de se separar, eles apostam uma moeda em um caça-níquel, ganhando três milhões de dólares. No entanto, as regras determinam que eles só podem ficar com o dinheiro se provarem que são um casal estável, o que os obriga a morar juntos.
programme.title: Jogo de Amor em Las Vegas

programme.desc: Benjamin Button é um homem que nasce idoso e rejuvenesce à medida que o tempo passa. Doze anos depois de seu nascimento, ele conhece Daisy, uma criança que entra e sai de sua vida enquanto cresce para ser dançarina. Embora tenha todos os tipos de aventuras incomuns, sua relação com Daisy o faz acreditar que os dois se encontrarão no momento certo da vida.
programme.title: O Curioso Caso de Benjamin Button

programme.desc: Reuben Feffer, um corretor de seguros, sabe tanto sobre os riscos inerentes a cada situação que é incapaz de se arriscar. Sua noiva, Lisa Kramer, parece perfeita para ele, mas o trai na lua de mel. Ao voltar para casa, em Nova York, Reuben reencontra a despreocupada ex-colega de classe Polly Prince, que o força a confrontar todas as suas neuroses.
programme.title: Quero Ficar com Polly

programme.desc: Uma brasileira recebe o diagnóstico terminal de câncer. Ela procura organização clandestina chamada Joy Transition International que diz ensinar aos seus clientes terminais a se suicidarem sem dor ou problemas em países onde a eutanásia é ilegal.
programme.title: Sonhar com Leões

programme.desc: Marcielle, de 13 anos, vive em uma comunidade ribeirinha na Ilha do Marajó com o pai, a mãe e três irmãos. Instigada pelas falas da mãe, ela cultua a imagem de Claudinha, sua irmã mais velha, que partiu para longe após "arrumar um homem bom" nas balsas que passam pela região. Conforme amadurece, ela vê suas idealizações ruírem e fica presa em ambientes abusivos. Ciente de que o futuro não lhe reserva muitas opções, ela decide confrontar a engrenagem violenta que rege sua comunidade.
programme.title: Manas

programme.desc: Seth é um anjo encarregado de tomar conta de Los Angeles, que se apaixona pela mortal Maggie, uma cirurgiã. Ela fica transtornada ao perder um paciente na mesa de cirurgia e Seth acompanha seu sofrimento e desenvolve por ela sentimentos que ameaçam sua condição imortal. Para viver esse amor intensamente, Seth considera desistir da eternidade.
programme.title: Cidade dos Anjos

programme.desc: Maria Alice vive em um casarão, bem na entrada de uma favela. Para sobreviver, faz os mais diversos bicos, mas sabe que o único meio de resolver seus problemas é vendendo a casa. O problema é que ninguém quer a comprar, devido à proximidade com o morro. Um dia, o filho de uma amiga, que é corretor de imóveis, diz que um estrangeiro quer comprar um imóvel na cidade. Maria pede que ele o leve à sua casa e, esperançosa que a venda aconteça, passa a organizar tudo para agradar o possível cliente.

programme.desc: As crianças da família Newton convencem os pais a adotar um filhote de São Bernardo, que cresce e acaba aprontando e dando muito trabalho. No entanto, o cão é uma criatura adorável e vira alvo das loucuras de um veterinário maluco.
programme.title: Beethoven - O Magnífico

programme.desc: Um homem e sua ex-esposa correm para Bali para impedir que sua filha se case. Enquanto tentam sabotar desesperadamente o casamento, a dupla brigona logo se vê reacendendo velhos sentimentos que um dia os fizeram felizes juntos.
programme.title: Ingresso para o Paraíso

programme.desc: Elizabeth Tudor torna-se a rainha de uma dividida e perigosa Inglaterra em 1558. Ela é vista como fraca por ameaças de todo lugar e é altamente aconselhada a se casar por um advogado William Cecil, mas ela só vai se casar com seu país. Inteligente e cautelosa, ela deve escolher onde colocar a sua confiança: com seu astuto secretário Walsingham, um mestre da espionagem, ou seu amante secreto, Sir Robert Dudley.
programme.title: Elizabeth

Um encontro fortuito sobre um suco de laranja derramado leva a um beijo que dá início a um caso de amor. Conforme ele e a glamorosa estrela de cinema se aproximam cada vez mais, eles lutam para conciliar seus estilos de vida radicalmente diferentes em nome do amor.
programme.title: Um Lugar Chamado Notting Hill

programme.desc: Frank Farmer, um guarda-costas altamente eficiente e caro, é contratado para proteger Rachel Marron, uma grande cantora e atriz que está recebendo cartas anônimas e ameaçadoras. Frank é um ex-agente do Serviço Secreto que ainda não se perdoou do sentimento de culpa em relação à sua inabilidade de proteger o presidente Reagan, que quase foi assassinado. Com o tempo, Frank e Rachel se apaixonam e logo ele se torna parte integrante do círculo íntimo dela. Paralelamente, novos atentados acontecem.
programme.title: O Guarda-Costas

programme.desc: No seu aniversário de 16 anos, Alexis é heroicamente salvo da morte por David, de 18 anos, depois do seu barco afundar na costa da Normandia. As férias de verão estão apenas começando e Alexis acaba de conhecer o amigo dos seus sonhos.
programme.title: Verão de 85

programme.desc: O relacionamento de um jovem casal se choca com as duras realidades da Corrida do Ouro na Califórnia de 1850. Angel, experimentando o amor pela primeira vez e enfrentando demônios que parecem insuperáveis, foge da nova vida que ela acha que não merece. programme.desc: Shrek e Fiona acabaram de voltar da lua de mel e vivem felizes em sua casa no pântano. O casal recebe um convite dos pais da princesa, que querem conhecer o novo genro, para um jantar no castelo. Eles ficaram sabendo que Fiona havia se casado com o seu verdadeiro amor, mas o que eles ainda não sabem é que este amor é um ogro mal-educado de mais de 300 quilos, que conta com um burro falante como melhor amigo.
programme.title: Shrek 2

programme.desc: Doente em estado terminal, o rei Harold chama Fiona e Shrek para uma conversa sobre a sucessão de seu reinado e o futuro do povo em Tão Tão Distante. Como o genro se recusa a assumir o trono e prefere continuar sua pacata vida no pântano, a única saída é encontrar o primo Artur. Na companhia do Burro e do Gato de Botas, Shrek se encarrega da missão e sai em busca do parente que pode ser seu substituto no trono. Mas, antes de cumprir a tarefa, enfrenta as armações do ambicioso Príncipe Encantado.
programme.title: Shrek Terceiro

programme.desc: Há muito tempo casado, Shrek fica com tédio e começa a ter saudades dos dias em que se sentia um ogro de verdade. Para recuperá-los, ele firma um pacto com Rumpelstiltskin e é levado a um mundo onde ogros são caçados e ele e Fiona nunca se conheceram, além de que seus amigos Burro e Gato de Botas também não o reconhecem. Shrek precisa encontrar um jeito de se livrar do contrato para recuperar sua vida normal e seu grande amor.

programme.title: Major Crimes

programme.title: Major Crimes

programme.title: Major Crimes

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! Mistério S/A

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! Mistério S/A

programme.title: Manda-Chuva

programme.title: Scooby Doo, Cadê Você?

programme.title: Scooby Doo, Cadê Você?

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! Mistério S/A

programme.title: Scooby-Doo! Mistério S/A

programme.desc: S1 E15 — Inverno um Tanto Quente Manda-Chuva fala muito bem sobre o Guarda Belo para uma revista. Para agradecer, o guarda decide deixar os gatos ficarem em sua casa durante o inverno. No entanto, o que o Guarda Belo não sabe é que tudo não passava de um plano de Manda-Chuva.
programme.title: Manda-Chuva

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Amor a Quanto Me Levas Ao visitar Batatinha no hospital, Manda-Chuva se apaixona perdidamente por uma enfermeira, a senhorita LaRue. Decidido a atrair sua atenção, Manda-Chuva finge estar doente e alega precisar dos cuidados especiais da enfermeira.
programme.title: Manda-Chuva

programme.desc: S1 E23 — Dois Sujeitos Aéreos Pensando que vão ser avaliados para uma competição de fitness, Barney e Fred acabam se alistando sem querer em um programa de três anos no exército. E, com essa confusão, acabam se tornando voluntários para levar a primeira espaçonave até a Lua.
programme.title: Os Flintstones

programme.desc: S2 E17 — Quase uma Estrela Durante as compras, Betty e Wilma param em uma farmácia, onde um produtor de TV vê as mãos de Wilma e decide contratá-la para seu novo projeto. Ela acredita se tratar de um papel grandioso, mas o trabalho é apenas o anúncio de um produto.
programme.title: Os Flintstones

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Lobo em Pele de Cordeiro Uma olhada nas acusações relativas ao "showrunner" Dan Schneider, incluindo um local de trabalho tóxico para escritoras e a prisão de dois membros da equipe por abuso infantil.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio da TV Infantil

programme.desc: S1 E3 — O Segredo Mais Sombrio Um ex-astro infantil revela como sobreviveu ao abuso nas mãos de seu coach de atuação. Em seu relato angustiante, ele revela que conheceu o abusador no set e os problemas que enfrentou quando procurou a polícia.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio da TV Infantil

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Perto Demais do Sol Um abusador é preso, mas recebe apoio de grandes nomes de Hollywood. Enquanto isso, o poder de Dan Schneider aumenta, suscitando dúvidas sobre o conteúdo e o tratamento dispensado ao elenco e à equipe técnica.
programme.title: O Lado Sombrio da TV Infantil

programme.title: O Lado Sombrio da TV Infantil

programme.desc: Mark tests out different tools that collect silica dust more efficiently; Richard shims a wobbly toilet; Kevin builds a wooden slice table with Jimmy Diresta, a famous maker.

programme.desc: Wide floorboards are installed to match the existing wood in the house. A sink is fabricated out of soapstone, and a backsplash is fabricated from an old board. Lighting installation wraps up.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune hunters.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The heaviest judgments of convicted killers are reserved for those who committed premeditated murder. These women plot and plan. They know the consequences of their actions, but still they go forward to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Behind lace-curtained windows and beneath sensible haircuts lurked evil. Appearances were deceptive. We did not notice these female killers walking by. These women wore a mask of sanity.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped, a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Heist
programme.desc: In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target
programme.desc: Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then, without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: Hogan's Heroes
programme.desc: The underground team that needs help in blowing up a mobile rocket-launcher battery includes a very lovely woman.

programme.title: Hogan's Heroes
programme.desc: The prisoners create an elaborate underground ruse to fool a German spy that has been placed in their ranks.

programme.title: Hogan's Heroes
programme.desc: Learning that the German army is manufacturing an improved Tiger tank, Hogan and his men are determined to steal one, so they can disassemble it and make blueprints for the Allies.

programme.title: Hogan's Heroes

programme.title: On the Case: Lying in the Darkness

programme.title: On the Case: Unfinished Journey

programme.title: On the Case: Murder by the Numbers?

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer Among Friends

programme.title: On the Case: A Predator in the Woods

programme.title: On the Case: The Doorbell Rang

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Warning

programme.title: On the Case: Gone in Less Than 3 Minutes

programme.title: On the Case: Unmasking a Killer

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope

programme.title: On the Case: The Green Dragon
programme.desc: A four year old boy's terrifying discovery sends police on the hunt for a vicious killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Hidden in Plain Sight
programme.desc: A nine year old girl scout disappears while delivering cookies to a neighbor.

programme.title: On the Case: Smoke and Ashes
programme.desc: A beautiful bride to be is murdered when a bomb explodes as she enters her home.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Betrayal
programme.desc: A beloved father of two is executed after a friendly poker game. Were the stakes too high? Or would police find the truth much closer to home?

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Family Values (REDUX)

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Goodbye So Long (REDUX)

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: The Most Wanted Man (REDUX)

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: The Half dense Players (REDUX)

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Eat Sin (REDUX)

programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite and his two daughters book the Tulip for a passage to Mars, Percy and the destructive young women become fast friends, creating serious trouble for Dante.

programme.desc: Dante is abducted by an Orchard agent (Tosca), in an effort to track down Travis. Tosca believes that he is the key to the Divinity Cluster.

programme.title: Salvation
programme.desc: - Harris, Grace, and Darius must topple the illegitimate government, and Darius makes final plans for the ark.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Her Pilgrim Soul/I of Newton
programme.desc: Two scientists named Kevin and Daniel are experimenting with a holographic device/ A mathematics professor accidentally makes a bargain with the devil and has to figure a way out.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Shatterday/A Little Peace and Quiet
programme.desc: A man named Peter Jay Novins accidentally dials his home phone number, and it's answered by Peter Jay Novins/A harried housewife finds a medallion that gives her the power to freeze time

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Gramma/Personal Demons/Cold Reading
programme.desc: A young boy cares for his grandmother, confronting fears to step up/A screenwriter with writer's block is haunted by unseen creatures/Actors in a radio play realize their words manifest reality.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Clare Wood
programme.desc: In April 2007, Clare Wood met George Appleton on a dating website and they embarked on a relationship together. Unbeknownst to her, Appleton was a criminal with a severe history of violence against women.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Marchioness Disaster
programme.desc: The story of the Marchioness; a pleasure boat that collided with dredger Bowbelle and sank within minutes resulting in the loss of 51 lives.

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Resolution To Kill: Colin Ireland
programme.desc: In the summer of 1993 a serial killer stalked London. The Metropolitan Police investigated a bizarre murder in which a man was found naked on his bed with a dead cat draped over him. He’d been strangled and his flat had been wiped of evidence.

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Bodies Of Evidence: Roger Severs
programme.desc: In November 1993, Derek and Eileen Severs disappeared without a word. When police spoke to their son, Roger, he insisted they were on holiday. However, there was no evidence of this apparent trip, and Roger was soon arrested on suspicion of murder.

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Body In The Suitcase: Lorenzo Simon
programme.desc: On 12th May 2014 a human torso was discovered in a suitcase during routine maintenance work on a Birmingham canal. With no useable DNA and no other body parts, the case initially seemed impossible to crack.
programme.sub-title: The Body In The Suitcase: Lorenzo Simon

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: DNA Of A Murder: Andrew George
programme.desc: Hilda Murrell, a 78-year-old distinguished rose-grower, was found dead in woodland near her home town. Despite a huge investigation by the British police, detectives failed to find her killer and conspiracy theories muddied the waters still further.
programme.sub-title: DNA Of A Murder: Andrew George

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Hitman And The Hairdresser: Fadi Nasri
programme.desc: A 29-year-old hairdresser was found brutally stabbed on her doorstep in a quiet suburban street of London. A recording of a threatening phone call seemed to suggest the motive, but every lead comes to a dead end.
programme.sub-title: The Hitman And The Hairdresser: Fadi Nasri

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Murder By Mail: Keith Cottingham
programme.desc: In 1984 a parcel bomb was sent to a 53-year-old grandmother living in a tranquil English village. She died of horrific injuries. No one understood why it had happened. The only evidence detectives had was the bomb itself.

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Time Of Death: Albert Walker
programme.desc: When a Devonshire fisherman hauled in his nets on July 28 1996, he made a gruesome discovery: among that day’s catch was a dead body. There was nothing to identify the man’s body except a Rolex watch and a small maple leaf tattoo on his hand.

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Dead Man's Hollow: Nishan Bakunts
programme.desc: In 2002, an off-duty fireman discovered a body in a field charred beyond all recognition. All the police knew was that the man had died a brutal death, having been stabbed repeatedly, shot in the head, and drenched in petrol before being set alight.

programme.title: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Into Thin Air: David Gilroy
programme.desc: It was a missing person’s case that shook the people of Scotland to their core. Within a week of Suzanne Pilley disappearing from her place of work in Edinburgh, police were convinced they were hunting for a killer - despite not having found a body.

programme.title: Killer Britain
programme.desc: Sana Muhammad, formerly known as Devi, had left her unhappy arranged marriage to Ramanodge Unmathallegadoo and remarried. She was a pregnant mother of five when he murdered her in her home.

programme.title: Killer Britain
programme.desc: Stephen Port was convicted of the assaults, rapes and murders of Anthony Walgate, Gabriel Kovari, Daniel Whitworth and Jack Taylor. He was sentenced to life imprisonment with a whole life order.

programme.title: Killer Britain: Vincent Tabak
programme.desc: When landscape architect Joanna Yeates disappeared after work Christmas drinks, the nation was gripped by the search for her. Tragedy struck on Christmas day morning when her body was found in a snow-covered lane. But who had killed the young woman

programme.title: Killer Britain: Peter Morgan
programme.desc: Millionaire Peter Morgan moved a young mother, Georgina Symonds, into one of his properties, paying her thousands a month to be his ‘girlfriend’. But when the relationship turned sour, he began plotting his revenge.

programme.title: Killer Britain: Sabrina Kouider
programme.desc: Sabrina Kouider couldn’t have lived such a glamorous lifestyle without the help of Sophie Lionnet, the young French au pair who looked after her children. What Sophie didn’t know was that her employer was gripped by frenzied delusions and paranoia.

programme.title: Britain's Darkest Taboos: My Secret Torment - I Was Abused By My Father
programme.desc: Alissa Moore was subjected to years of horrific sexual abuse at the hands of her father James O’Brien. Former Detective Superintendent David Swindle and psychologist Emma Kenny examine the horrific details of the case.
programme.sub-title: My Secret Torment - I Was Abused By My Father

programme.title: Britain's Darkest Taboos: He Trapped Our Sons In The Attic, Then Set Fire To The House
programme.desc: On the 22nd of October 2014 Darren Sykes lured his sons Jack and Paul into the attic then set fire to the house. Jack and Paul’s mother Claire Throssell reveals how Darren's behaviour spiralled out of control and the devastating impact of his actions.
programme.sub-title: He Trapped Our Sons In The Attic, Then Set Fire To The House

programme.title: Britain's Darkest Taboos: My Mother Murdered By Her Golden Boy Son
programme.desc: Ross Taggart dialled 999 on the 23rd of December 2014 to report his mother Carol missing. Two weeks later he was charged with her murder. David Swindle and Emma examine how a son could commit such a callous act.
programme.sub-title: My Mother Murdered By Her Golden Boy Son

programme.title: Alien Files Unsealed
programme.desc: Countdown To Disclosure: Evidence suggests the world's governments could be on the verge of announcing everything they know about UFOs. What will this mean for our society?

programme.title: Alien Files Unsealed

programme.title: Dynasty: The Bordello
programme.desc: Walter takes Steven to a bordello; Steven is blamed for sabotaging Matthew's rig; Krystle pawns her diamonds to help Matthew financially.

programme.title: Dynasty: Krystle's Lie
programme.desc: After being fired for sabotaging Matthew's equipment, an innocent Steven learns he was set up; Lindsay is shattered to learn about her birth; Blake tries to learn who bankrolled Matthew; Fallon warns Steven's ex-lover to stay away from her brother.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Necklace
programme.desc: Matthew and Walter's well comes in; Fallon asks to borrow the necklace Krystle pawned to help Matthew; at his mountain cabin, Steven and Claudia make love.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Beating
programme.desc: Steven announces he is moving out of the mansion; the chauffeur, Michael, tells Blake of Steven's affair with Claudia; Fallon resumes relations with Michael, until Blake has the chauffeur worked over; Lindsay sees her mother with Steven.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Birthday Party
programme.desc: Blake learns Krystle pawned her emerald necklace to help out Matthew; Fallon tells Jeff she married him solely for her father's welfare; Steven's former lover, Ted, arrives in Denver.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Separation
programme.desc: Steven tells Claudia he spent the night with Ted; Krystle leaves Blake; seeing Ted embrace his son, Blake strikes him; Steven accuses his father of murder.

programme.title: Dynasty: Blake Goes to Jail
programme.desc: Blake must stand trial for the murder of Steven's lover; Krystle returns home to be with Blake. Fallon testified in her father's behalf but Steven refutes her statements in court.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Testimony
programme.desc: On the witness stand, Blake maintains his innocence; Matthew learns of Claudia's affair with Steven; Claudia and daughter Lindsay are involved in an automobile accident; The prosecution calls in a mysterious witness that Blake is surprised to see.

programme.title: Dynasty: Enter Alexis
programme.desc: Blake's first wife Alexis testifies that Blake is capable of violence; Matthew takes off with Lindsay; Alexis tells Steven of her love for him; the jury announces they have reached a verdict.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Verdict
programme.desc: Blake is found guilty; Krystle reunites with her husband; Blake strikes Steven; a pregnant Krystle suffers a fall; Alexis moves onto the Carrington estate.

programme.title: Dynasty: Alexis' Secret
programme.desc: Krystle orders Alexis from the mansion; Blake instructs his attorney to cut Steven out of his will; Claudia attempts suicide; Alexis tells Steven that he is Blake's only child.

programme.title: Dynasty: Fallon's Father
programme.desc: Alexis tells Cecil Colby that Fallon is his daughter; Blake and Steven are urged to reconcile; Dr. Toscanni pulls an unconscious Steven from the pool and rushes him to the hospital.

programme.title: Dynasty: Reconciliation
programme.desc: Steven returns to the mansion to recover from injuries sustained by his fall; Krystle's niece, Sammy Jo, arrives to spend a few weeks with the Carrigtons; Alexis hires a private investigator to delve into Krystle's past.

programme.title: Dynasty: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Nick reveals to his sister that Blake is responsible for the death of their younger brother; Sammy Jo and Steven spend the night together; Alexis shoots at Krystle's horse, causing her to be thrown to the ground and hospitalized.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Miscarriage
programme.desc: Krystle loses her baby; Steven and Sammy Jo begin dating, although Steven is in love with Claudia. Fallon continues her affair with Nick, and is jealous to find him visiting Krystle in the hospital.

programme.title: Dynasty: Mid-East Wedding
programme.desc: Fallon learns she is pregnant and tells Jeff she is having an abortion; he agrees to divorce her but only if she bears the child. Krystle remains despondent over the loss of her baby; Claudia takes a job with Denver-Carrington.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Psychiatrist
programme.desc: Alexis tricks Blake into coming to Rome and further traps him by hiring a gossip photographer to snap suggestive photos of the two; Jeff begs Fallon to cancel her abortion; as Nick confronts Krystle, his consolation gives way to passion.

programme.title: Dynasty: Sammy Jo and Steven Marry
programme.desc: Nick tells Krystle of his deep feelings for her; Steven and Sammy Jo marry; Fallon cancels her abortion; after the scandal caused by the papparazzi photos of Alexis and Blake, Krystle leaves her husband.

programme.title: Arthur: Binky Rules/Meet Binky
programme.desc: Writing your own name in graffiti all over the school wouldn't be very smart, right? Binky says he didn't do it, so detectives Fern and Buster are on the case. Then, Binky is the newest, hottest, hippest pop music craze in Elwood City.

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's Faraway Friend/Arthur and The Square Dance
programme.desc: Arthur's in the midst of writing a great adventure story with Buster when he gets some very bad news--Buster is leaving town to go live with his Dad for a while. Then, does Francine have a crush on Arthur?
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Faraway Friend/Arthur and The Square Dance

programme.title: Arthur: Meek For A Week/Arthur, World's Greatest Gleeper
programme.desc: Muffy bets Francine she can't be nice to everyone for a whole week--and soon wishes she hadn't. Next, Arthur didn't mean to tell a lie, he just got stuck in a sort of fib, because he thought it was cool to be a Gleeper.
programme.sub-title: Meek For A Week/Arthur, World's Greatest Gleeper

programme.title: Arthur: Molina's Mulligan/Buster Bombs
programme.desc: Alberto discovers he has a natural talent for golf and begins to compete, but will his dad's embarrassing cheers make him give it up? Buster has lost his flair for funny, and the harder he tries to make people laugh, the worse it gets.

programme.title: Arthur: Desk Wars/Desperately Seeking Stanley
programme.desc: When Mr. Ratburn moves Brain and Arthur away from their usual desks, it sets off a chain reaction resulting in the most explosive desk war in third grade history! And, Arthur is 8-years old now—does he still need his teddy bear?

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's Pet Business/D.W. The Copycat
programme.desc: How can Arthur prove to his parents that he's responsible enough to take care of his very own puppy? "Get a job," suggests D.W.!. Yet another personality change for D.W., who's decided that from now on, she'll be just like Arthur.

programme.title: Arthur: D.W.'s New Best Friend/Freaky Tuesday
programme.desc: D.W. meets 13-year-old Hana, who is much older and totally cool! Is Hana D.W's new BFF? Then, Buster is convinced teachers have it easy. Can he put himself in Mr. Ratburn’s shoes to find out what it’s like to be a teacher?

programme.title: Arthur: Buster Baxter, Cat Saver/Play It Again, D.W.
programme.desc: A cat gets stuck in a tree and Buster Baxter saves the day! Risking life and limb! Next, the ridiculous Crazy Bus song is EVERYWHERE, but mostly it's in the Read's home, because D.W. has to play it 4000 times a day.
programme.sub-title: Buster Baxter, Cat Saver/Play It Again, D.W.

programme.title: Arthur: Just Desserts/The Big Dig
programme.desc: Arthur has a hard time resisting sweets, and one evening his overindulgence wins him an upset stomach and some 'Grimm' dreams. Arthur and D.W. loved it when Grandpa Dave came to visit--but now he only wants to sleep and play checkers.

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's Eyes/Francine's Bad Hair Day
programme.desc: For some reason, Arthur isn't doing very well in school anymore. Maybe he just needs some glasses? Problem is, Arthur hates having to wear them. And it's school picture day and Muffy is determined that Francine will look her best.

programme.title: Arthur: Phony Fern/Brain's Shocking Secret
programme.desc: When Fern's parents give her a cell phone for emergencies, she soon becomes hooked on it. Brain is the smartest kid in class. Everyone knows that! What they don't know is that he was kept back in Kindergarten. Will Binky spill the beans?

programme.title: Arthur: Fountain Abbey/Arthur Calls It
programme.desc: Muffy's devastated when she learns her great, great grandmother Mary Alice wasn't royalty, but a common maid. Pressure from his classmates has Arthur doubting his decision to call Buster out during a baseball game.

programme.title: Arthur: 1001 Dads/Prunella's Prediction
programme.desc: When Buster insists that he will miss the Father's Day picnic because he has other plans, Arthur is convinced that he's really sad and embarrassed about his parents’ divorce. And Prunella predicts a gift of flashpants, the hot new fashion.

programme.title: Arthur: Maria Speaks/Postcards from Binky
programme.desc: Maria has always been a silent fixture in Mr. Ratburn's third-grade class. But her time to speak has finally come. Can she fix her stutter? When Binky's grandparents miss his big soccer game, he decides to film a video reenactment.

programme.title: Arthur: Buenas Noches, Vicita/Prunella Packs It In
programme.desc: Vicita Molina has lost her favorite bedtime book – can Arthur help her re-create it? Prunella is already starting to think about college! Will she crack under the heavy load or will she learn to relax and do the things she actually enjoys?
programme.sub-title: Buenas Noches, Vicita/Prunella Packs It In

programme.title: Arthur: Sue Ellen Adds It Up/Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: Math, schmath. That's what Sue Ellen thinks… until she runs into a problem her artistic vision can't solve. Sue Ellen can't wait to meet her pen pal in person.
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Adds It Up/Wish You Were Here

programme.title: Arthur: Fernkenstein's Monster/D.W., Dancing Queen
programme.desc: Inspired by Mary Shelley's "Frankenstein," Fern tells a tale so scary that Arthur and the gang become afraid of her! Then, Binky decides to teach D.W. to dance, but she just doesn't seem to get the moves. Is D.W. a no-talent klutz?

programme.title: Arthur: Blabbermouth/All Grown Up
programme.desc: Buster is hurt when he learns his friends don't trust him to keep a secret. Then, the gang finds a mysterious fortune telling game at the library and gets a hint of what their futures could hold.

programme.title: Arthur: Francine's Cleats of Strength/Little Miss Meanie
programme.desc: When Francine needs money for new soccer cleats, Muffy hires her as a personal assistant. Lydia and Muffy join forces to defeat a mean beauty queen in the Little Miss Crocus" pageant.
programme.sub-title: Francine's Cleats of Strength/Little Miss Meanie

programme.title: Arthur: Fernlets by Fern/Prunella and the Haunted Locker
programme.desc: Muffy talks Fern into writing poems for a new line of greeting cards which becomes the hit of Elwood City, but booming business causes Fern to burn out. Prunella is assigned a new school locker, which is rumored to be haunted!
programme.sub-title: Fernlets by Fern/Prunella and the Haunted Locker

programme.title: Arthur: Cast Away/The Great Sock Mystery
programme.desc: Arthur is thrilled when Dad invites him to go fly-fishing for the weekend. But a change in plans forces them to include D.W. Find out once and for all where socks disappear to when Baby Kate and Pal team up to solve the great sock mystery.

programme.title: Arthur: Binky's Music Madness/Brain Freeze
programme.desc: Everyone loves the Bang on a Can All-Stars, a funky experimental music group that's touring around Elwood City. Everyone that is, except Binky. A new ice cream shop has just opened up across the block. Will Brain's shop be able to survive?

programme.title: Arthur: The Cherry Tree/Matchmaker Matchbreaker
programme.desc: Muffy wants a Bouncy Castle at her party, but when her favorite cherry tree is cut down to make room for it, she starts to have regrets. Francine and Muffy scheme to set up their older siblings Chip and Catherine, but plans go awry.

programme.title: Arthur: Dear Adil/Bitzi's Break-Up
programme.desc: Arthur is worried that his letters to his new Turkish pen pal, Adil, will be boring. After all, how can Elwood City compare to Arthur's fantastical ideas about Turkey? Bitzi is breaking up with her boyfriend, and Buster is really sad.

programme.title: Arthur: The Agent of Change/D.W. Unties the Knot
programme.desc: The latest animated hit movie about a boy and his truck has left Muffy and Francine disappointed. Why doesn't there seem to be any cool female characters on screen? After watching "The Wedding Channel," D.W. wants to get married!
programme.sub-title: The Agent of Change/D.W. Unties the Knot

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice
programme.desc: What happens when you combine Greek Mythology with D.W.'s imagination? Then, getting two Polly Locket dolls almost ruins Prunella's birthday party. That, and Francine's bad mood--why, she wouldn't even sing the Happy Birthday song!
programme.sub-title: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice

programme.title: Arthur: The Blackout/Mei Lin Takes a Stand
programme.desc: It's a hot day in Elwood City, and a total blackout leaves its residents without electricity! Will Arthur and DW survive without AC and TV? Binky's baby sister Mei-Lin isn't keen on learning to walk and would rather stick to crawling.
programme.sub-title: The Blackout/Mei Lin Takes a Stand

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur Babysits/Arthur's Cousin Catastrophe
programme.desc: You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

programme.title: Arthur: The Butler Did...What?/The Trouble with Trophies
programme.desc: Bailey is missing! Muffy discovers a series of clues and is left wondering, who exactly IS Bailey? Then, everyone loves getting trophies, right? It turns out that Fern could not care less about them.
programme.sub-title: The Butler Did...What?/The Trouble with Trophies

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur's Numbers Nightmare/Brain Gets Hooked
programme.desc: When the gang discovers a list of their class rankings in Principal Haney's office, they are all taken for a surprise. Brain gets hooked on the latest tween reality show and then starts to ignore his friends and his schoolwork.

programme.title: Arthur: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior
programme.desc: Arthur and friends are all faced with seemingly impossible tasks, from fixing a model biplane to babysitting D.W. And, Buster knows he's fun, but he's beginning to feel like he's not particularly good at anything.
programme.sub-title: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior

programme.title: Arthur: Arthur and The Crunch Cereal Contest/D.W. Flips
programme.desc: A year's supply of Crunch Cereal is in store for the person who can write the new Crunch Cereal jingle, and Arthur is sure he can do it. Next, how hard can it be to do a cartwheel on a balance beam? D.W. is about to find out.

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: Goobacks: South Park is swamped by workers from the future, who take all the jobs for less pay. The men of South Park go to unusual lengths to stop them. "Dey turk err jurbs!" (S8, E07)

programme.title: South Park: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: The Jeffersons: A new family arrive in South Park with a little boy called Blanket, a fairground in the garden and a dad with a penchant for singing and cosmetic surgery. Guess who? Shamone! (S8, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Douche and Turd
programme.desc: Douche and Turd: The pupils of South Park Elementary are called to vote for a new mascot. With the choices being a "giant douche" and a "turd sandwich" is there any point? (S8, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
programme.desc: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes: When a mall is built in South Park, the townsfolk become addicted to shopping - it'll take the boys hunting down its evil "heart" to end their misery! (S8, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Preschool
programme.desc: Pre-School: The boys are pooping their pants after hearing that Trent, a notorious bully from their pre-school years, is being released from juvenile hall - guess who put him there? (S8, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Quest for Ratings
programme.desc: Quest For Ratings: When the gang's school news programme trails far behind Craig's show, "Animals Close-Up With a Wide-Angle Lens", they pledge to boost their ratings - how far will they go? (S8, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Stupid Spoiled ***** Video Playset
programme.desc: Stupid Spoiled ***** Video Playset: Paris Hilton opens a store in South Park, corrupting the town's girls in the process. It's up to Mr Slave to put things right - time for a "***** off!" (S8, E12)

programme.title: A Haunting: Ghost Confessions
programme.desc: An unknown entity appears to find pleasure in terrifying 17-year-old Macy Sherman, her younger sister Kelsey and their mom Carrie. The family reaches out for help, praying that they can get rid of the spirit intent on staying in their home forever.

programme.title: A Haunting: Trapped In Terror
programme.desc: Soon after moving into an older home in a quaint suburb of Cincinnati, OH, Taylor Jones catches her mother practicing black magic in her daughter Isabelle’s bedroom. Her fears become reality when Taylor notices Isabelle playing with an invisible friend.

programme.title: A Haunting: Fear Feeders
programme.desc: Soon after Al Gonzalez purchases a home outside Fort Wayne, Indiana, he begins to hear strange noises and sees unexplainable shadows. Paranormal investigators determine the entities in Al's home are dangerous and that he is not their first victim.

programme.title: A Haunting: Demon Unearthed
programme.desc: In the small town of Garden Grove, Iowa, Jennifer and Norman Rice with their son Andrew, purchase a majestic 19th century mansion. Soon after, Jennifer and Andrew begin experiencing paranormal activity while Norman is out of town on business.

programme.title: A Haunting: Casa de los Muertos
programme.desc: Eddie Benitez fears the spirit of a dead man who committed suicide is slowly killing his son.

programme.title: A Haunting: Living Nightmare
programme.desc: Angela, a newlywed, is excited to start her new life with Stephen when nightmares that she experienced as a child suddenly resurface. Soon the menacing old hag from her dreams terrorizes her daughter and takes temporary possession of her son.

programme.title: A Haunting: Legend Trippers
programme.desc: High school classmates test out an old ghost story on Halloween night.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Shadowman
programme.desc: Tim Yancey and his older brother Tom love playing in the woods surrounding their Florida home. One afternoon Tom senses a presence watching him from among the shadows. Days later, the same entity confronts Tim and chases him through the woods.

programme.title: A Haunting: Haunted Victorian
programme.desc: After moving in their dream home, Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero begin to experience strange occurrences; mysterious footsteps and unexplained noises. Lillian is physically attacked while sleeping and the couple tries to escape, but is it too late?

programme.title: A Haunting: The Apartment
programme.desc: The Spencer’s move to a new apartment that is loud with spirits.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Presence
programme.desc: Sarah Miller believes that something supernatural in her home is terrorizing her children.

programme.title: A Haunting: Gateway to Hell
programme.desc: Bobby Mackey has heard tales that the river by his club draws Satanists to the area.

programme.title: A Haunting: Norman the Doll
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator, Stephen Lancaster, doesn’t believe in haunted objects until he captures proof the doll he recently acquired is haunted. Fearing he is in over his head, he attempts to get rid of it, but the doll has other plans.

programme.title: A Haunting: A Haunting in Ireland
programme.desc: The Fahey family’s new addition stirs up psychic energy of a crime committed years ago.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Exorcism Of Cindy Sauer
programme.desc: Georgia single mother Cindy Sauer is finally getting back on her feet after the sudden death of her husband. But as she is recovering from her loss, nightmares and dark shadows haunt the family and mark the beginning of something far worse.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Romie moves into a new home but begins to have nightmares and see shadowy spirits pacing.

programme.title: A Haunting: Ghostly Voices
programme.desc: Angelina Balistreri believes her home is haunted by a harmless ghost, while her husband, Emiliano, is skeptical of the paranormal. They call in a priest and medium who makes contact with a troubled ghost and helps him cross over and find peace.

programme.title: A Haunting: Grave Awakenings
programme.desc: When ghosts confront Zoe Dei, she makes the harrowing discovery that her home harbors a paranormal portal which has awakened her dormant ability as psychic medium, forcing her to learn how to live with her newfound ability to see the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting: Hell House
programme.desc: Bonnie and her family buy a farmhouse and they sense that they are being watched.

programme.title: JAG: The Brotherhood
programme.desc: During a landing exercise Marines find a beaten, comatose fellow Marine on the beach

programme.title: JAG: Hemlock
programme.desc: By mistake a foreign agent sends a fax to Meg's office; then he retrieves it and shoots Meg to prevent her from identifying him

programme.title: JAG: High Ground
programme.desc: A Marine sniper receives orders contrary to a previous deal; his CO refuses to listen; the sniper takes a shot at the CO's Humvee.

programme.title: JAG: Smoked
programme.desc: After a lightning strike, an F-14 wanders into Cuban airspace, and Cuban fighters force it to land

programme.title: JAG: Black Ops
programme.desc: A Naval aviator, while temporarily assigned to a SEAL team, drowns at sea; he was the son of a woman senator.

programme.title: JAG: Survivors
programme.desc: In a civilian court Harm represents a divorced (and emotionally baffled) Marine colonel, who has gotten into trouble over an unauthorized visit with his minor son.

programme.title: JAG: Recovery
programme.desc: A Navy astronaut dies during a drill while preparing for a space mission to repair a satellite

programme.title: JAG: Prisoner
programme.desc: Chicom agents capture Harm in Hong Kong; they vigorously question him in mainland China about official matters.

programme.title: JAG: Ares
programme.desc: Someone kills a Naval officer on Okinawa, then his ship encounters major trouble during war games at sea

programme.title: JAG: Skeleton Crew
programme.desc: The body of a woman Naval officer, a friend, and classmate of Harm, is found ashore.

programme.title: JAG: Trinity
programme.desc: Harm and his new partner, Marine Major Sara MacKenzie are drawn into a game of revenge when they're sent to Belfast, Ireland, to represent the legal interests of a Navy Lieutenant whose infant son has seemingly been abducted.

programme.title: JAG: Secrets
programme.desc: Admiral Chegwidden, Mac and Bud Roberts are taken hostage in the Admiral's office by Pvt. Magida, a Marine who escaped from a nearby Federal prison.

programme.title: JAG: Ghosts
programme.desc: Harm and Mac investigate an attempt on Admiral Chedwiggen's life and uncover the fact that all the members of his former SEAL team have died under mysterious circumstances.

programme.title: JAG: Full Engagement
programme.desc: While on their day off, Harm takes Mac for a flight in his vintage airplane, only to be forced to make an emergency landing in a mountain clearing because of mechanical problems.

programme.title: JAG: Cowboys and Cossaks
programme.desc: Harm, Mac, and Bud are assigned sea duty to monitor a joint war games exercise between U.S. and Russian naval forces.

programme.title: JAG: The Guardian
programme.desc: Harm and Mac defend Bauwer, a former Navy Seal, now a homeless man, who's accused of using excessive force when he killed three men who tried to hold up a convenience store.

programme.title: JAG: Rendevous
programme.desc: Mac and Harm once again find themselves courtroom adversaries as Mac is assigned the difficult task of defending CPO Holst, an admitted wife abuser accused of murdering his wife's boyfriend.

programme.title: JAG: Ghost Ship
programme.desc: Harm and Mac investigate the discovery of a skeleton found hidden aboard a decommissioned aircraft carrier that is being cut up for scrap, and learn it is all that remains of a long-missing JAG officer.

programme.title: JAG: The Court Martial of Sandra Gilbert
programme.desc: The top female gunship pilot at the Yuma Marine Base is charged with disobeying an order to stop "fraternizing" with her crew chief, a married, enlisted man. Mac is assigned as prosecutor and Harm is set as Susan's defense attorney.
programme.sub-title: The Court Martial of Sandra Gilbert
